title: Brandon Aiyuk blasts Jayden Daniels for laughing exchange with 49ers fan: ‘Turn your savage up’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aiyuk blasts Jayden Daniels for laughing exchange with 49ers fan: ‘Turn your savage up’
sources.description: Bitter 49ers receiver Brandon Aiyuk did not appreciate Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels laughing with a fan who despises Aiyuk.
